9a37bfb4-3c61-4dc7-a8c4-b90e6733edc1: <size value='l'>     This questionnaire is designed to measure the effects of your inflammatory bowel disease on your daily function and quality of life. You will be asked about symptoms you have been having as a result of your bowel disease, the way you have been feeling in general, and how your mood has been.</size>
e2d901b6-e846-405c-be77-0c6d96c9b5aa: <size value='l'>     On this questionnaire there are 32 questions. Each question has a graded response numbered from 1 through 7. Please read each question carefully and select the number which best describes how you have been feeling in the past 2 weeks.</size>
